name: Twin
author: James Myers
description: Find the same file twice. Scans by size, then by a partial hash, then in full - so a disk full of unique files costs almost nothing to check. Hard links are reported as links, not offered up for deletion, and the last copy can never be removed.

schema.label: Folders to scan
schema.description: Colon-separated. Empty means your home directory.

schema.label: Skip hidden files
schema.description: Leaves dotfiles and caches alone, which is where most false positives live.

schema.label: Ignore files under (KB)
schema.description: Tiny files are duplicated constantly and reclaiming them is not worth the risk.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: The widget appears while scanning or when there is something to look at.
